Script to perform SC analysis for dropseq data of mDA differentiation of PINK1 vs CTRL cells.

```{r}
#| label: importing libraries
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridisLite)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)
library(slingshot)
```


```{r}
#| label: parameters

input_file = "./data/SeuratFinal.rds"
output_folder = "./results/"

#to export things later
writeExcel = TRUE
```
